title: Average pay by department
statementMd:
For each department name, show the average salary rounded to 2 decimals. Include only departments that have employees.

Expected columns: `department`, `avg_salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name AS department, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
